definitions.full: H74. Abner אֲבִינֵר proper name, masculine ( my father is Nêr , or is a lamp compare 2Sam 21:17 ; accusative to Lag BN 75 = אֲבֶן (= בֶּן ) + נֵר = son of Ner; compare ᵐ5 Ἀβεννηρ ) — so only 1Sam 14:50 , elsewhere אַבְנֵר — cousin of Saul, and captain of his host 14:50-51 , 17:55 (3 t. in verse) + 52 t. 1 & 2Samuel; + 1Kin 2:5 , 32 ; 1Chr 26:28 ; 27:21 .
definitions.rootNote: or (fully) אֲבִינֵר ; from 1 and 5216 ; father of light (i.e. enlightening);
